core_meaning.primary_meaning: Kitab corresponds to the Arabic form كتاب and is glossed in this record as “Book, scripture.” The record associates the form with root ك ت ب (k-t-b). The lexical gloss describes the word-form; Qur’anic occurrence, religious recommendation, popularity, and a name-bearer’s character are separate claims and are not established by this gloss alone.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Kitab corresponds to the Arabic form كتاب (Arabic root ك ت ب (k-t-b); كِتَاب (Kitāb)). Its core sense is book, scripture. Kitab is Arabic كِتَاب (Kitāb) 'book, scripture', from the root ك ت ب (k-t-b). The source gloss 'The Book' is consistent. Recorded at medium confidence because the word is primarily a common noun.

persian.name: کتاب
persian.long_meaning: Kitab (کتاب) نامی برگرفته از زبان عربی است و معنای اصلی آن کتاب، دفتر است. این نام در جوامع مسلمان به کار می‌رود و کاربرد آن بسته به بافت زبانی متفاوت است.

hindi.name: किताब

arabic.name: كتاب
